component.name: Amaya
component.summary: WYSIWYG editor for structured web pages

description.p: Amaya edits web pages as they look: you type, select and restyle text on the formatted page, and Amaya keeps a clean, valid document structure underneath (XHTML, CSS, MathML, SVG). It is also a simple web browser.
This is an unofficial port of Amaya 11.4.7, the editor developed by W3C and Inria until 2012, to current Linux systems.
